title: Prove the sharp common-five P112 deletion bound
body:
## Summary

```text
P112, one seven-space and ONE common deletion set
  at most five cuts: at most two distinct directions
  six cuts: explicit independent orthogonal triple
```

Prove the sharp common-five deletion lemma over every characteristic-zero field, for directions whose residual binary label rank is at most seven. This resolves [PR3230](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3230)'s named handoff; its separate-five counterexample has a different contract.

Adds only `research/p112-common-five-deletion/`, with the proof, literal witness, two finite implementations, complete receipts and replay instructions. Exact commit `f27442f87cf1fd86a50b8ba15615d8d655d06a85`, base `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19002963). TASK.json records the scope change from generic helper synthesis to this explicit handoff.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 for Lemma N and the decoder-floor reduction, Nick Petalas/PR3230 for the separate-five boundary and question, and the retained PR3161/3162/3169 E8/P112 geometry lineage, including joaqcoo. Development and verification used substantial automated assistance; no independent human review is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: separate five-line cuts admit three independent directions, but their common union has eight lines. The common-five question was open.
- After: all 43,435 seven-spaces, 121 live-trace classes, 1,200 candidate directions and 148 affordable completions prove the common-five bound. An independent lattice/RREF/dual-functional implementation reproduces the complete table. Six common cuts give a literal triple with Gram determinant 512.
- Registered Python 3.12.15/GCC14 replay and thirteen optimized behavioral groups pass. The exact committed read-only, Git-free export passes all three commands under optimized Python 3.13.5; Clang19 also reproduces the primary receipt. All fifteen publication files match committed bytes.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common-five-deletion
```

The written classification uses the standard real Weyl-chamber theorem and a rational-nullspace field transfer. No new historical profile exclusion, full C5, decoder floor, supplier or kappa is claimed. [Hosted planning and the complete package replay both passed](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39061877799) at exact head `f27442f87cf1fd86a50b8ba15615d8d655d06a85`. Two unsuppressed Ruff S603 trust-boundary reports are documented in README.md and CHECKS.json.

Open next question: bind a still-open caller's literal single common support and retained code dimension before applying this lemma. Separately affordable cuts do not supply that hypothesis.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One new opt-in package and one declared unchanged geometry input. Frozen predecessors and the selected result are unchanged. Retaining this package does not admit a supplier or certify a multiplication theorem.
